items.headline: AI Hallucinations Lead to Legal Vulnerability for WJ Werzyn and West Shore

The case drew regulatory attention regarding AI integration into professional services and whether new mandates for human-in-the-loop verification are necessary.

items.headline: EU AI Act Transparency Obligations Preparing for Compliance by 2 August 2026
items.summary: Article 50 transparency obligations of the EU AI Act take effect 2 August 2026, requiring conformity assessments, technical documentation, CE marking, and EU database registration for high-risk AI systems. Organizations must implement transparency solutions for artificially generated content by 2 December 2026. Member States must establish operational AI regulatory sandboxes by 2 August 2026.
